content.text:
services:
  data_store_backend:
    build:
      context: ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend
      args:
        INDEX_URL: ${PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}
    command: sh scripts/start-server.sh
    volumes:
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend:/app
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend/data_store:/data_store
    container_name: data-store-backend-service
    ports:
      - 8007:8000
    environment:
      - API__ENVIRONMENT=COMPOSE_ALL=== portal_backend ===
services:
  portal_backend:
    build:
      context: ../../../../../../apps/portal_backend
      args:
        INDEX_URL: ${PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}
    command: sh scripts/start-server.sh
    volumes:
      - ../../../../../../apps/portal_backend:/app
    container_name: portal-backend-service
    ports:
      - 8000:8000
    environment:
      - API__ENVIRONMENT=COMPOSE_ALL
    depends_on:
      portal_backend_db_migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/compose/dev && cat services/data_store_backend/service.yml && echo "=== portal_backend ===" && cat services/portal_backend/service.yml
